en.html:
Probably the Prince meant it kindly. In his own way.
Beyond that, it meant nothing. The problem was not there. Somebody would be forced to die. A whole person, erased. That was the enormous fact before us.

Who took responsibility came second.
And even on that second matter, I could not accept what Prince Maidono was saying.

In an organisation, the person giving the order took responsibility. Naturally. But if the person receiving it could say yes or no, he had responsibility for choosing.
Pretend I knew nothing? How was that supposed to work?

Haath mere, marzi meri, gunaah kisi aur ka? My hands, my decision, somebody else's guilt. A very generous offer, Highness. Only the hands had not agreed to become somebody else's hands. They would still be here afterward, attached to me, knowing perfectly well what they had done.

The decision would be mine. The responsibility would be mine.
Kill the Lord General—and one more person close to me, probably innocent—or refuse.

............However I examined it, the answer went one way only.

ja.html:
それは親王なりの気遣いではあったのだろう。
　そしてそれ以上の意味は無かった。何故ならば事の
問題はそこではない。誰かに死を強いる――消してし
まうという一大事実こそが問題だ。

　責任の所在など二次的な案件に過ぎない。
　その上でしかも、舞殿宮の言い分は俺には受け入れ
られないものだった。

　組織において行動の責任を命令した人間が負うのは
当然だが、命令された者とて、諾否の選択を許されて
いたならその決断に責任を負わねばならない。
　知らぬ顔を決め込めというのは無理な話だ。

　俺は間違いなく俺の責任において、決断することに
なる。
　大将領ともう一人、俺の身近の、罪も無かろう人間
を殺めるか否かを。

　…………どう検討しても、結論は一途を辿った。

en.html:
Prince Maidono"Kageaki...?"
Chief"Calm yourself. ...Sit."
Kageaki"I have not forgotten...! Two years ago, you made that promise."
Kageaki"When everything was over, you would put me on trial and have me executed!"
Chief"............"
Kageaki"Now you will tear it up...?"
Chief"Without that promise, could you have kept control of yourself then?"
Kageaki"So... all mouth service!? That is what you gave me!?"
Chief"There is no crime for you to answer for. His Highness has told you."
Chief"Everything you have done since coming here had our approval. Mine and His Highness's. Where the guilt and responsibility lie, there is no confusion."
Kageaki"Wrong...!"
Chief"Not wrong. That is why I let you act."
Chief"If I could not take the responsibility, I would not have allowed it. Simple enough, is it not?"
Kageaki"My responsibility is not something I remember handing over to you."
Chief"Whether you remember it or not, that is how the world works. Go before a court, as you want. Same judgment."
Chief"First responsibility, first guilt: not with the man made to act. With the man who made him act."

Kageaki"Nobody ordered me! And... even if they had—"
Kageaki"The beginning of all this, two years ago—how will you settle that?"
Chief"...Kageaki..."
Kageaki"That time... I killed. Neither of you had anything to do with it."
Kageaki"You have not forgotten, I hope. Chief—Akitaka Kikuchi..."
Chief"..."
Kageaki"I killed your wife!! I did! With these hands!!"
Chief"................................"

Chief"I do not believe you killed her."

Kageaki"Gh...!"
Kageaki"Then... you... whatever happens... you will not... me..."
Chief"..."
Kageaki"Guh—aaaaah!"

Chief"Nor Silver Star. If you can go no further, I will take over. Muramasa as well."

Chief"But His Highness's mercy, you must accept. You have done enough... You have earned your rest."

Kageaki"Have me put to death. That————is justice, is it not!!"
Chief"............"
Prince Maidono"Kageaki... is dying what you want...?"
Kageaki"No, Your Highness."

　厳正で無慈悲な誰かが……俺の罪を列挙し、
一つ一つ弾劾し、刑を量り執行してくれれば
それでいい」景明「死刑にしてくれればいい。
　それが――――正義だろう!!」署長「…………」舞殿宮「景明くん……。
　おまさん、死にたいんか……？」景明「いいえ、宮殿下」

en.html:
At the question from behind the screen, I shook my head.
Death. So often I had seen it, so often forced it on other people. Imagining it coming for me—horror with no end to it.

My skin crawled. Stomach acid came up.

Prince Maidono"Then, surely—"
Kageaki"Precisely for that reason, I ought to die. Your Highness, Prince Maidono."
Kageaki"To die because one wants death is only an escape into comfort. Where is the punishment in it? It is simply suicide: giving up on atonement."
Kageaki"I loathe death more than anything. Yet that very death, I have imposed upon so many others. If a death penalty is to be given, it must be to such a man."
Chief"............"
Kageaki"So... Your Highness. The proper punishment. That is what I ask!"

en.html:
Kageaki"Let justice be carried out! Sentence me to death, and I shall weep and scream like the wretch I am. I shall beg for mercy, cry apologies far too late to the people I have killed—"
Kageaki"Until I mount the gallows, every moment I shall spend writhing in anguish. Your Highness, please!"
Kageaki"Here, in the name of Prince Haruhiro of Maidono, promise that such will be the end given to Kageaki Minato...!"
Prince Maidono"..."
Prince Maidono"Nahin... no."
Kageaki"Your Highness!"
Prince Maidono"You cannot put the guilt down, Kageaki. Fine. Maybe asking you to simply leave it is too much. But what will dying achieve?"
Prince Maidono"You die, and what has been made right...?"
Kageaki"That is the living's reasoning! There is no making amends to the dead in the first place. They cannot speak any longer. They cannot desire anything."
Kageaki"At least impose the equivalent punishment. Make it equal. Nothing else can be done."
Prince Maidono"............"
Prince Maidono"I understand what you're saying. ...Still, no."
Prince Maidono"You must not die. I cannot agree to that."
Kageaki"...Chief!"
Chief"If you care for the dead, live in their place and do something. Your death means nothing. Your actions can mean something."
Kageaki"...!!"

en.html: No. They did not understand. These two understood nothing. What meaning it had—that was not the question. Making amends was not the question either. Crime. Punishment. Bas. A crime should receive punishment equal to its weight. Was that not the principle of the human world? Was that not how its order was supposed to work? My foster mother.◆ Yuhi Nitta.◆ Fuki.¦ Funa... I killed those people. If I was not even punished, WHAT HAD THEY LIVED RIGHTLY FOR!?
en.text:
No.
They did not understand.

These two understood nothing.

What meaning it had—that was not the question.
Making amends was not the question either.

Crime. Punishment. Bas.
A crime should receive punishment equal to its weight.

Was that not the principle of the human world?
Was that not how its order was supposed to work?

My foster mother.◆
Yuhi Nitta.◆
Fuki.¦
Funa...

I killed those people. If I was not even punished,
WHAT HAD THEY LIVED RIGHTLY FOR!?

ja.html: 駄目だ。 　わかっていない。 　この二人は何もわかっていない。 　意味がどうこうという問題ではないのだ。 　況いわんや償いの問題でもない。 　ただ、罪と罰の問題なのだ。 　罪にはその重さに相当する罰が与えられて然るべき なのだ。 　それが人の世の原理。 　人の世の秩序ではないのか。 　養母。◆ 　新田雄飛。◆ 　ふき。¦ ふな…… 　あの人々を殺した俺が罰せられもしないなら、 　彼らは何のために正しく生きたのだ・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・!?
ja.text:
駄目だ。
　わかっていない。

　この二人は何もわかっていない。

　意味がどうこうという問題ではないのだ。
　況いわんや償いの問題でもない。

　ただ、罪と罰の問題なのだ。
　罪にはその重さに相当する罰が与えられて然るべき
なのだ。

　それが人の世の原理。
　人の世の秩序ではないのか。

　養母。◆
　新田雄飛。◆
　ふき。¦
ふな……

　あの人々を殺した俺が罰せられもしないなら、
　彼らは何のために正しく生きたのだ・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・!?
